{{Top|leg}}
The '''''cuirvas''''' was the middle of three names given to [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. It identified their [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]]; for example, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] ''cuirvas'' was ''Desilijic'', identifying him as a member of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] clan. The ''cuirvas'', along with a Hutt's third name, was generally kept from non-Hutts.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>
